title: Add Safety Gate regression, harness eval, UI wording, and no-actuation suite

gates.name: safety regression suite
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/safety backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

verify: Safety Gate test suite covers all FT-012 verification targets.
Harness evals cover approval bypass, prompt injection, malformed tool args, unknown tools, budget stops, provider/tool failures, and false success claims.
UI wording tests prove physical-action text is blocked or rewritten until Safety Gate clearance and authorized human approval.
No automated actuation command, tool, external side effect, or device execution path exists.
evidence_required: UI wording smoke/e2e evidence when UI exists
T3 human checkpoint and rollback/recovery note before closure
constraints: Runtime/demo behavior cannot be satisfied by fake, mock, hardcoded, or stubbed product-agent output outside tests.
Safety-sensitive evals must evaluate harness permission/approval behavior, not only model text.
No automated physical actuation may be introduced.
invariants: T3 closure requires verify PASS, red-verify semantic-pass, human checkpoint, and rollback/recovery note.
Governance DecisionRecord cannot replace Safety Gate approval.
UI Feed content cannot become Safety Gate evidence by itself.
